sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: CITGO Asphalt Refining Company and Frescati Shipping Company disagree on the meaning of a safe berth clause in their 2004 contract. The clause governs the transport of oil to CITGO's berth on the Delaware River. The parties chose this form contract from industry standards. They now argue over what the safe berth term legally requires.

Frescati wants the court to interpret the clause as guaranteeing the berth is safe.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the scope of safe berth clauses in shipping contracts. It determines who bears the risk of unsafe destinations. It affects how parties draft and price these agreements. It clarifies the legal standard for shipowners and receivers.
